expert_troubleshooting.yellowing_bottom_leaves: Nitrogen (N) Deficiency. (Source: USDA Standard). Apply top-dressing of urea during tillering.
expert_troubleshooting.purple_tint_stems: Phosphorus (P) Deficiency. (Source: FAO Soil Map). Occurs in cold soils. Apply DAP or SSP.
expert_troubleshooting.burnt_leaf_edges: Potassium (K) Deficiency. (Source: BUMI Intel). Critical for grain filling. Apply MoP.
expert_troubleshooting.loose_black_heads: Loose Smut (Fungal). Ustilago nuda. (Source: PlantVillage). Destroy infected plants; use solar seed treatment for next season.

expert_troubleshooting.yellow_center_leaves: Zinc (Zn) Deficiency (Khaira disease). (Source: Data.gov.in). Apply Zinc Sulfate spray.
expert_troubleshooting.bronzing_leaves: Iron (Fe) Deficiency. (Source: FAO). Common in calcareous soils. Use Chelated Iron spray.
expert_troubleshooting.narrow_brown_spots: Brown Spot. Helminthosporium oryzae. (Source: PlantVillage). Increase potash application.
expert_troubleshooting.empty_white_panicles: Stem Borer attack. Scirpophaga incertulas. (Source: BUMI). Use pheromone traps or tricyclazole.

expert_troubleshooting.reddening_leaves: Magnesium Deficiency. (Source: Data.gov.in). Apply Epsom Salt.
expert_troubleshooting.boll_dropping: Water stress or Ethylene imbalance. (Source: USDA). Maintain uniform moisture.

expert_troubleshooting.blossom_end_rot: Calcium Deficiency. (Source: PlantVillage). Check soil pH and watering consistency.
expert_troubleshooting.leaf_curl: Whitefly transmitted virus or Heat stress. (Source: BUMI). Use yellow sticky traps.
